thread:
maria: Heads-up — scheduling a deploy + FF ramp tonight in the 23:00 PST change window. Plan below, TL;DR: slow spin up, pin backend version for short soak, clear rollback gates. Please ack if you can watch. :eyes:

maria: Feature flag: `search_v2`
- ramp: 1% -> 5% (10m) -> 25% (10m) -> 100% (10m)
- backend pin: `search-service` -> v3.1, pin for 2h post-100%
- metrics to watch: error_rate (5m), p95 latency, infra GPU mem pressure, token cost delta
- rollback triggers: error_rate > 1.5x baseline OR p95 latency > 2x baseline OR any data corruption report
- release notes updated: https://internal/release-notes/2026-03-searchv2 (short summary added)

deploy-bot: queued deploy job #5421 for 2026-03-22T23:00Z in change window (preflight checks: PASS).

ashley: ack, I can watch first 30m. Who’s got the CLI flip if I need to run it?

maria: @ashley I’ll do the first flip. If I’m offline, jon — you have the pin/unpin flow, right?

jon: I do. Quick pin/unpin commands:```bash
# pin route to v3.1 for 2h
route-pin set search-service --version v3.1 --duration 2h
# rollback unpin (if needed)
route-pin clear search-service
```

ashley: thanks. How do we update the flag percentages via infra?

maria: two ways: featurectl or curl to flagger. Example:```bash
featurectl set --env prod --flag search_v2 --percent 1 --note "canary start"
# or quick curl
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/v1/flags/search_v2/target -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_TOKEN' -d '{"percent":1}'
```

kevin: What are the exact baselines? I want to prewire alerts.

sre-oncall: Baselines pulled from last 7d window: error_rate = 0.12%, p95 = 280ms. I'll open a watch dashboard and attach thresholds: error_rate_alert = 0.18% (1.5x), p95_alert = 560ms (2x). I'll also enable a short-term spike detector for token_cost delta > 25%.

deploy-bot: preflight logs:
- checksum(model artifacts): OK
- infra quotas: ok
- canary shard available: yes
- rollout policy set to staged-incremental

deploy-bot: starting canary now (23:00:30Z) — search_v2 -> 1%

maria: flipping to 1% now. pinging observability. :rocket:

sre-oncall: saw a tiny blip on error_rate + latency at t+2m but within expected variance. continuing to monitor.

deploy-bot: canary metrics healthy at t+10m -> increasing to 5%

ashley: 5% live. I’ll keep eyes on customer-facing logs for anomalies.

jon: pinning backend to v3.1 now (2h) — command returned OK.

deploy-bot: 25% ramp at t+22m -> started; running gradual slice shift

kevin: no unusual backlog or GPU pressure on infra cluster. token_cost +8% so far. ok for now.

sre-oncall: p95 stayed ~300ms, error_rate still ~0.13%. no alerts.

deploy-bot: 100% ramp completed at t+45m. finalizing rollout.

maria: great — leaving pin on for 2h soak. I’ll add a follow-up note to the release thread and mark the change window closed. Thanks everyone for watching. :tada:

deploy-bot: deploy job #5421 COMPLETE — summary: canary ok, ramped to 100%, pin v3.1 applied for 2h.

ashley: super. I’ll standby in case the token_cost trend continues; might drop quantization suggestion in Optimize if it drifts.

maria: if any regression appears, we follow rollback checklist in the runbook: rapid flag 0% -> clear pin -> roll back DB migration (if any). Everyone, add any postmortem notes to the release notes page within next 24h.

jon: noted. removing my write lock on pinning playbook.

sre-oncall: will keep alerted channel watch until pin expires.

kevin: closing infra loop for this window.

maria: closing thread — final last_message_ts=5302468075. Thanks all. :heavy_check_mark:
